boundary: This audits c_+/c_- coverage in the existing primitive-ray ledger. It identifies unordered primitive ratio classes and missing lambda orientations; it does not add no-point certificates or prove any lambda-family exclusion.
coverage_interpretation: c_+/c_- covers unordered primitive ratio classes {A:B, B:A}. A defined class still needs lambda-oriented family proof or a reviewable no-point certificate before it can be promoted.
